m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: What in the sands? First, the Ferals swipe our stash, and now some random Wizard invades the Roost?
This is not some random Wizard. This is the one who's been working for Sultana Sharzad. Prepare yourself - this will not be an easy fight.
There you have it. According to those Goons, we're starting to get a bit of a reputation. We've earned it, haven't we? I certainly think so.
Well now, isn't this a treat? A Wizard with a bounty on his head, and a talking skull with a gemstone for an eye. I'm going to be rich! Haha!
You like that? That's what you get for eyeing my eye. It's mine! You see! Hah! I mean it, Wizard. I'm not giving up this Eye. It's all I got.
Ah, the illustrious Wizard serving as Sultana Sharzad's enforcer! Ali Baboon is proud to make your acquaintance! Come in and be welcome!
Ah, very good, very good. Ali Baboon is smart, you see? Ali Baboon and Wizard will be fine friends. Yes. He is determined to make it so.
Ali Baboon is hated by Ferals and Fangs. He does not want more enemies, especially not the proud Sultana and the beautiful Djinni, Istar.
The Sultana sent you, yes? What does she wish of Ali Baboon? Truce talks? Ha! But this is no imposition. It is a gift to Ali Baboon!
Like Sultana, Ali Baboon only wants peace and order in Aggrobah. Yes. Tell Sultana that Ali Baboon will attend talks. He looks forward to it.
Over there, is door to street. You may use that door, Wizard, and you are welcome to return any time you like. Ali Baboon is fine friend. Yes.
Ah, Wizard, I am so happy to see you. Tell us, did Ali Baboon agree to attend the talks? He did? It was that easy? Hmm. Very well.
You know, nice as he seemed to be, I'm just going to venture a guess here, and say he probably shouldn't be trusted...
Most certainly not. If he will attend our talks, however, that is progress in the right direction.
Faizal! I trusted you! How could you do this! Have you been telling the gangs about our plans as well?
He's been talking, eh? I can put a stop to that. I know just the thing! Shazam! Now you can't talk to anyone!
Mmm? Mmm! Mmm!
And now he can't tell us who he was working for, either...
Oops. Sorry, Master.
It's all right, Istar. I have a feeling I already know. It's Ali Baboon, isn't it?
Mmm... Mmm-hmm.
So Ali Baboon wants to play rough? Fine. Wizard, Ozzy, raid the Roost and confront him. He can attend our truce talks or leave town.
I hope you don't think I take your loyalty for granted. I could not do this without you. After this, I will help deal with this Overlord Xerxes.
